stored_text.note: Neither stored file holds the text of the standard. official.html is the SAMR national-standards catalogue entry (number, Chinese and English titles, status, publication and implementation dates, issuing bodies). secondary.html is the TC260 news item of 2025-06-30 that links to the full-text PDF (/zgwabwuploadfile/1751257342816036759/1751257342816036759.pdf), but the PDF itself was not stored. Title, number, dates and status can be checked; the content of the summary cannot.

english_version.publisher: Center for Security and Emerging Technology (CSET), Georgetown University

evidence.quote: 英文标准名称：Cybersecurity technology—Basic security requirements for generative artificial intelligence service

english_version.note: The SAMR catalogue gives an official English title only (evidence quote); no English text of the standard is stored. One web search found no SAMR foreign-language edition (国家标准外文版) of GB/T 45654-2025, only an unofficial translation by CSET. The CSET page is a lead and was not stored.
